sections.title: Scope saved records
sections.spoken_text: The snapshot method loads the owned desk data, then keeps only conversations, tickets, refunds and audit rows belonging to the host-selected customer. Orders come from the fixed synthetic fixture for that same customer. The model never supplies the customer scope through a tool argument. This view makes cross-customer records invisible in the lesson report.

sections.title: Settle exact approval
sections.spoken_text: The approval waiter accepts only the pending exact call. It waits for one answer with a timeout. Whether approval succeeds, is denied, times out or is cancelled, the pending entry is removed. A later call cannot reuse that decision. The refund handler also checks the run, conversation, call and token before it writes an effect.

sections.title: Close into CRM
sections.spoken_text: A local CRM close first requires the selected open conversation and copies its messages. It builds strict structured CRM data, persists the close and reloads the saved state. Success requires a closed status, the same CRM record and an unchanged transcript. The native close uses a restricted fork with no support tools, then checks the same host facts.
